arithmetic_to_the_goal.honest_reading: Every identified lever together lands the sampler near 1.45 s against the 1.042 s needed for 24 fps with decode pipelined. That is about 15.6 fps continuous, up from 10.0 now. The remaining 1.4x has no identified lever yet; the excess over roofline is activation-bound elementwise work, not weight reads.
